description: env-doctor: a SessionStart hook that runs cheap read-only checks (project .mcp.json, Syncthing ignores, host disk / WSL pressure) and speaks only on a problem, and a PreToolUse advisory on Bash/PowerShell that reminds Claude to background jobs longer than ~3 minutes. Neither ever blocks.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start_env_advisory.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
